participants.note: Approach ACK with ~4x speedup benchmark; raised nonblocking concerns on next_index drift and mapWallet clear order

claims.harm: descriptor next_index drift causes successive iterations to derive different change addresses and invalidates drift assertion comment assumptions
claims.quote: The descriptor's `next_index` isn't reset here, so the same input builds a different transaction depending on how many ran before it.

claims.harm: clearing mapWallet before wtxOrdered and m_txos leaves latent dangling references
claims.quote: mapWallet.clear() runs before wtxOrdered and m_txos, and both point into it. Nothing dereferences in between so it's latent
claims.settled_by_quote: No reason, will leave as is but can think about it in case I have to touch it again. Thanks.

support.reason: Ran the qa-assets corpus on master and on this head, the speedup reproduces, around 4x here.

result.notes: jeanpablojp provided an Approach ACK after confirming a ~4x speedup on qa-assets. Both inline concerns from the previous assessment are confirmed and resolved: the next_index comment was updated in a force-push, and the mapWallet clear order rationale was accepted without pushback.
